[[bench]]
name = "dtoa_benchmark"
harness = false

[package]
name = "pretty_dtoa"
version = "0.3.0"
authors = [ "Matthew Torrence <matt@torrencefamily.net>",]
edition = "2018"
description = "Configurable floating point number to string conversions, with many options for controlling various aspects of displaying floats."
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/pretty_dtoa"
homepage = "https://github.com/torrencem/pretty_dtoa"
repository = "https://github.com/torrencem/pretty_dtoa"
keywords = [ "float", "double", "display", "dtoa",]
categories = [ "value-formatting",]

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.3"
rand = "0.7.3"

[dependencies]
ryu_floating_decimal = "0.1.0"
